item.title: In Canada: Spotify Raises Premium Prices, Marking First Major Canadian Hike in Nearly 2 Years
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, music lovers. Welcome to our podcast. Today, we're talking about the latest news from Spotify Canada. If you're a premium user, you might want to sit up and take notice, as prices are going up. Starting in July, most premium services will see an increase of $1 to $3 per month."
[Short music transition]
Host: "According to an email sent to users, the price hike will vary depending on your account type. The good news is that student accounts will remain the same price, at $6.39 plus tax. Spotify says the increase will allow them to invest more in their premium services and deliver the best possible experience for users."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This is the first major price hike for Spotify Canada in nearly two years. The last increase was in 2024, which was partially inspired by the 'streaming tax' implemented by the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission. We'll be keeping an eye on how this latest price hike affects users and the music industry as a whole."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in. If you want to learn more about the price increase and its impact on the music industry, check out the link in our show notes."
